title: OPORD 01035 — Eastern corridor
content:
OPERATION ORDER
1. Situation: maintain awareness in Eastern corridor.
2. Mission: NATO Response Cell monitors assigned area.
3. Execution: synchronize ISR and maritime reporting.
4. Sustainment: report logistics constraints.
5. Command and Signal: use approved NATO C2 channels.
